description: The factor account at this address, for its owner only: the factor and its terms, the mandate's limits, approved desks and payees, the balance sheet by desk in dollars (FactorAccount.balanceSheet()), fees owed and recent moves. Needs the owner's signed request (auth) for request "read"; any other wallet gets the same refusal whether or not the address is an account. On chain the account's balances and moves are public anyway.

account.description: The factor account's 0x address (open_account returns it). Accounts are found by address, never by agentId.

auth.description: The account owner's signed request: sign the text account_request_message returns (EIP-191 personal_sign) with the owner's own key; it must recover to owner(), so a contract-wallet owner cannot use these tools yet. Good for five minutes; issued may be at most 30 seconds ahead.

issued.description: The ISO 8601 UTC time in the signed text.

name: balance_sheet
title: Factor accounts: read your account
